messages:
sam_support: FYI customer ACME-FIN (ticket #ACME-4772) is asking for ISO 27001 mapping for audit logs, retention policy, and KMS/HSM attestations. They also reported missing audit entries that line up with a spike of 502s last Wed. Can security + SRE take? Auditor meeting Friday.
lia_security: Thanks — can you paste the exact ask from the auditor? do they want the control mapping table (A.12/A.18) or just evidence (logs, retention config, HSM cert)?
sam_support: Short from auditor: 'Provide mapping to ISO27001 controls for audit logging and key management, retention config for 90/365 days, sample logs covering last 90 days, and confirmation of HSM backed CMK with key custody flow.' They also called out missing events: examples attached in ticket.
noah_sre: I took a quick look at the prod logs for the window they flagged. looks like audit flush fails if upstream returns 502 and connection abort happens before queue flush. low-volume reproducer below.
noah_sre: Repro steps:
```
# reproduce locally against staging
curl -v -X POST https://staging.api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST" -d '{"prompt":"x"}' --limit-rate 10
# then send a rapid sequence of aborts (ctrl-c) while the request is inflight
```
noah_sre: Quick grep to find missing audit markers:
```
kubectl logs -l app=api -n prod --since=4h | grep "audit.event"
kubectl logs -l app=api -n prod --since=4h | grep "flush_failed"
```
lia_security: OK — that pattern matches an existing known issue where the audit buffer isn't force-flushed on connection termination. we have a mitigation but need evidence for the auditor: config that says retention (S3 lifecycle + log-index retention) and HSM certs. I'll prepare the mapping table. @noah_sre can you pull a small sample of 10 events that show successful and 5 that are missing (context: request id, user id, model id)? we should not include PII.
noah_sre: Will do. I'll pull events with request-id and obfuscate user ids. command I plan to run:
```
# fetch audit events with request id
aws s3api get-object --bucket redwood-audit-prod --key audit/2024/11/12/segment.jsonl tmp.jsonl
jq -r '.event | {rid:.request_id, t:.ts, typ:.type} ' tmp.jsonl | head -n 50
```
jules_prod: Heads up — auditor asked about retention >90 days. We charge for longer retention on the enterprise plan. If they want 365d for all audit indices we'll need to confirm billing with customer. pinging finance.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Deploy 2024-11-12T03:22:11Z rolled to prod (sha: a1b2c3). No incidents reported.
sam_support: Auditor set meeting for 2024-11-15 10:00 PST. deadline to send packet: EOD Thu (2024-11-14). Lia, can you own the mapping doc? Noah pls attach log samples. Jules can confirm retention billing. Mike, any specific attestation wording you need?
mike_auditor: Prefer an official statement on letterhead for HSM usage and key custody. Also a short mapping table linking our auditor control ids to your internal docs. sample logs fine as long as request ids are present. thank you.
lia_security: Understood. I'll assemble: control mapping table, retention config screenshots (S3 lifecycle + ES index settings), HSM certs + KMS key policy extract. I'll mark redactions for any customer-sensitive fields.
noah_sre: I'll collect 10x success events + 5x examples where an upstream 502 coincided with missing audit entries. will add repro steps and a short remediation note: set `audit.flush_on_disconnect=true` (staging patch ready) and a scheduled fix in the runtime queue handler.
sam_support: Great. I'll update ticket ACME-4772 and inform customer we're assembling package and will share by Thu EOD. tagging owners: @lia_security (mapping + evidence), @noah_sre (log samples + repro), @jules_prod (billing/retention). :thumbsup:
lia_security: I'll also attach the ISO mapping CSV and link to internal confluence page for auditors. adding compliance sign-off block for legal to review.
sam_support: thanks all — filing this as escalation.high and linking to incident timeline in the ticket. any blockers call out now.
noah_sre: only blocker is S3 access perms for the sample pulls — will request a scoped temp role if needed. I'll request it from infra.
jules_prod: I'll confirm cost estimate and reply in the ticket.
mike_auditor: sounds good. appreciate the quick turnaround.
sam_support: closing loop here — will post final packet link in ticket when ready."
